newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Treasurer sells $164 mln of refunding bonds.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Treasurer sells $164 mln of refunding bonds.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong said on Friday his office sold $164 million in state public works board refunding revenue bonds in two separate sales.
Fong said his office sold $143 million in 1996 series A lease revenue refunding bonds for the California State University system.
The second issue was the sale of $21 million in lease revenue refunding bonds for the outstanding California Community Colleges 1991 term bonds.
Fong said his office took advantage of improved market conditions to sell the refunding bonds.
"We continue to watch the market closely and decided to take advantage of a small window of opportunity to generate significant savings for taxpayers," Fong said.
